# semaphore_ex_integration_alias (Data Source)

An integration alias — a unique webhook URL that callers POST to in order to trigger the linked integration's template task.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_integration_alias" "example" {
  id         = 3
  project_id = 1
  # Set integration_id = 2 for an integration-scoped alias.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The alias ID.
- `project_id` (Number) The project ID this alias belongs to.

### Optional

- `integration_id` (Number) The integration this alias is bound to. When set, the alias only triggers the named integration. When omitted, the alias is project-scoped — incoming requests use SemaphoreUI's matcher rules to pick which integration to run.

### Read-Only

- `url` (String) The fully-qualified webhook URL callers POST to. Generated by SemaphoreUI at create time and immutable afterwards.
